about: Starter meals for 'Plan the rest of my day' (docs/dev/research/06-meal-guidance.md §4.7 option 3): the four meals of the sample day in docs/diet-guide.md §6 (CKD G3b-G4 with type 1 diabetes, not on dialysis). Items reference builtin foods by USDA fdc_id (data/foods.json); servings are in that food's serving (e.g. 0.75 x '1 cup' = 3/4 cup). A combo is offered only when every food exists, and only after the same meal check as any other plan option. Edit by hand; tests/guidance/test_data.py checks every id and the carbohydrate totals against the guide.

combos.name: Sample-day breakfast: cream of wheat, blueberries, egg, toast and coffee
Sample-day snack: applesauce and peanut butter

items.as: Peanut butter, 1 tbsp (the food list has regular peanut butter: about 65 mg more sodium than the guide's unsalted one)

combos.name: Sample-day lunch: turkey sandwich, salad and pineapple
Sample-day dinner: chicken, rice, green beans and cauliflower

items.as: Chicken breast, roasted, 2 oz (the serving is 86 g)
